paragraphs: Allison Haunss is an Emmy award winning journalist who has reported on some of the biggest stories in the New York area including the mid-air plane/tourist helicopter collision over the Hudson River, the attempted car bombing in Times Square, and the Pope's 2008 visit to NYC.

Allison joined WPIX in November 2007 as a freelance reporter. Prior to filing stories for WPIX, Allison was one of the main weeknight anchors at News 12 Connecticut, where she anchored the Monday through Friday news at 5:30 and 10pm. While at News 12 Connecticut, Allison traveled to Israel for an in-depth Emmy award winning series entitled "Grandma Guard," examining one Stamford, CT woman's journey through the Israeli civil guard. Before News 12 Connecticut, Allison worked as a reporter in Westchester and on Long Island, and in television markets including Pittsburgh and Sioux Falls.
Allison graduated from Duke University and earned a master's degree in broadcast journalism from Northwestern University's Medill School of Journalism.
As of this 2014 record, she resided in New York City.
